social_formats.description: Partner ballroom dance executed in social salon settings or regional folk gatherings.

movement_profile.formation_and_space: Partner ballroom spacing in traditional context; ballet spatial staging in Nebrada's Nuestros valses
movement_profile.partnering: Paired ballroom hold in social settings
movement_profile.tempo_feel: Brisk, jumping, and elastic syncopated feel

music_profile.musical_form: Two-part structure in salon waltzes; three-part structure in popular oral tradition waltzes; 8-bar melodic phrasing
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Syncopated 3/4 with off-beat silences breaking European metric symmetry
music_profile.sound_description: Characterized by an eight-measure broken melody that plays with silences and off-beat accents over standard three-quarter time. Salon versions feature solo piano or classical guitar, while regional popular versions use bright lead violins or bandolas anchored by rhythmic strumming on the cuatro and guitar.
music_profile.vocal_style: Romantic lyric singing in vals-canción and vals pasaje forms

teaching.formation: Partner dance in salon settings; theatrical ballet formations in stage works
teaching.rhythm: 3/4 meter with syncopated silences, cross-rhythms, and 8-bar melodic phrasing
